## 2. Hosting and website access

This website is hosted using **GitHub Pages**, a service provided
by GitHub.

When you access this website, technical information is transmitted
to GitHub's servers. GitHub states that visitors' IP addresses
are logged and stored for security purposes, regardless of whether
they are signed in to GitHub.

Additional technical information, such as browser details,
requested resources, and access times, may also be processed
as part of the operation of the hosting service.

The purpose of this processing is to provide the website and
maintain its technical functionality and security.

The legal basis for processing under my responsibility is
Article 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interests). My legitimate
interest is to provide a functional and secure personal website.

GitHub may process personal data outside the European Economic
Area, including in the United States. GitHub describes the
applicable data transfer safeguards in its privacy statement.

Further information:
  
  [GitHub Privacy Statement](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement)

## 3. Contact form

This website provides a contact form that allows visitors to
send messages without directly using an email application.

When you submit the form, the following information is processed:
  
  - Name, if provided (optional)
- Email address (required)
- Message content (required)
- Technical information associated with the submission

The information is used exclusively to process your inquiry,
communicate with you, and respond to your message.

The legal basis is Article 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interests).
My legitimate interest is to respond to inquiries from visitors,
researchers, potential collaborators, and other interested persons.

Where your inquiry concerns steps prior to entering into a
contract, Article 6(1)(b) GDPR may apply instead.

Providing your information is voluntary. However, an email
address and a message are necessary to submit an inquiry
through the contact form and receive a response.

### Contact form processing through Form.taxi

The contact form is processed using **Form.taxi**, operated by
wrkt*biz Reinhard S??llradl, Austria.

Form.taxi receives, processes, and delivers the information
submitted through the form.

According to Form.taxi, submitted information is processed and
stored exclusively within the European Union. Its hosting
infrastructure is located in Dresden, Germany.

In addition to the information entered into the form,
Form.taxi processes the sender's IP address, browser
identifier (user agent), and submission date and time.

These technical data are used for form delivery, spam prevention,
and security.

Form.taxi acts as a data processor under Article 28 GDPR.

Further information:

[Form.taxi Privacy Information](https://www.docs.form.taxi/en/privacy)

### Email delivery

Contact form submissions are forwarded to my email inbox
through the email notification functionality provided by Form.taxi.

My email service is provided by **Proton AG**, Switzerland.

Switzerland is recognized by the European Commission as providing
an adequate level of data protection under Article 45 GDPR.

Further information:

[Proton Privacy Policy](https://proton.me/legal/privacy)

### Retention of contact requests

Personal data submitted through the contact form is retained
only as long as necessary to process the inquiry and any
related correspondence.

Messages are deleted when they are no longer required,
unless continued retention is necessary for legal obligations
or the establishment, exercise, or defense of legal claims.

According to Form.taxi, submissions are automatically deleted
from its submission archive after a maximum of one year.
Submissions classified as spam are deleted after one month.

Copies of correspondence stored in my email account are
managed separately and deleted when they are no longer needed
for the purposes described above.

## 4. Cookies and tracking

The contact form on this website uses standard HTML and does
not require JavaScript, advertising cookies, or external
tracking scripts.

The form itself does not use analytics or marketing technologies.

Technical information may nevertheless be processed by the
hosting provider and the contact form service as described
in the preceding sections.

This website contains links to external websites, including

When you follow an external link, you leave this website.

## 6. Your rights under the GDPR

Under the GDPR, you have the following rights, subject to
the applicable legal conditions:

- **Access (Article 15):** Request information about your
  personal data being processed.
- **Rectification (Article 16):** Request correction of
  inaccurate personal data.
- **Erasure (Article 17):** Request deletion of your
  personal data.
- **Restriction (Article 18):** Request restriction
  of processing under certain circumstances.
- **Data portability (Article 20):** Receive your personal
  data in a structured, commonly used, machine-readable
  format where this right applies.
- **Objection (Article 21):** Object to processing based
  on legitimate interests under the applicable conditions.

To exercise these rights, please use the
[contact form](contact.qmd).

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a
competent data protection supervisory authority.

The supervisory authority in Saxony is:

**S??chsische Datenschutz- und Transparenzbeauftragte**

[www.datenschutz.sachsen.de](https://www.datenschutz.sachsen.de/)
